caption: The drawing features a single, ornate teapot placed centrally on the page. The teapot has a bulbous, rounded body set on a stepped, circular pedestal base. It is depicted in a silvery-grey color with purple, gold, and beige shading that gives the object a metallic, reflective appearance. The teapot's lid is domed with fluted edging, and a decorative finial sits on top. The spout is intricately decorated with leaf and scroll motifs and projects to the left, while the large handle, which echoes the decorative motifs, arches to the right. Toward the bottom right corner of the page, there is a small technical drawing of the same teapot in simple linework, annotated with measurements: the height is labeled as 12 inches, the span (from spout to handle) as 10.5 inches, and the body diameter as 6 inches. The background is plain and uncolored, and a thin square border encloses the main illustration. At the bottom of the page, there are handwritten notations with the text "156-1 DEL.156-1 ERNEST TOWERS JR."
title: Silver Coffee Pot
